description: A full Pomodoro timer: configurable focus sessions, short and long breaks, session dots, cycle counter and an audible chime on every phase change.

faqs.a: Work in focused 25-minute blocks separated by 5-minute breaks; after 4 blocks take a longer 15–30 minute break. All durations are configurable here.

faqs.q: Does the timer keep running if I switch tabs?
faqs.a: Yes — it is driven by wall-clock timestamps, not by counting ticks, so it stays accurate even in a background tab.
Yes: focus length, short break, long break and how many focus sessions come before a long break are all adjustable.

howto: Set your focus, short-break and long-break lengths (defaults 25 / 5 / 15).
Choose how many focus sessions come before a long break.
Press Start — the timer runs Focus → Short break → … → Long break automatically.
Skip a phase any time, or Reset to start a fresh cycle.
title: Pomodoro Timer
